name: UNA Pizza Napoletana
kurzbeschreibung: **Enjoy authentic UNA Pizza Napoletana in Innsbruck** – where the fiery heart of Naples meets the alpine charm of Tirol. Savor the true taste of Italy with our handmade, wood-fired pizzas, crafted with love and tradition. From classic **Margherita** to bold **Diavola**, every bite is a journey to the sun-drenched streets of Napoli. **Why choose us?** ✔ **Certified Neapolitan dough** – just like Nonna used to make it ✔ **Fresh, local ingredients** – Tirol’s finest meet Italy’s flavors ✔ **Wood-fired perfection** – crispy yet soft, with a smoky aroma ✔ **Authentic recipes** – no shortcuts, only passion **Come for the pizza, stay for the vibe** – our cozy spot in Innsbruck is the perfect mix of Italian flair and Tiroler Gemütlichkeit. Pair your meal with a glass of **Lagrein** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** for the ultimate alpine-Italian experience. **UNA Pizza Napoletana – Where Tirol meets Napoli!** 🍕❤️ --- *Visit us | Follow us | Book a table*
